purpose: Teach: ヴァン/タナ/サーキット/アロマ/ウルトラマン/エヴァ/ドス/ゴキブリ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ヴァン・ヘイレンのギターは凄い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad was saying Van Halen's guitar playing is incredible.
lines.style: Gentle storytelling warmth, slight playful emphasis when quoting his dad, unhurried and smiling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「タナくんの絵本」読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Daddy read the Tana-kun picture book!
lines.style: Small voice brightening fast, eager little rush on the book title, proud finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「F1サーキット見学に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad said you two should go visit an F1 circuit together.
lines.style: Warm rising excitement on the invitation, leaning toward him, soft encouraging finish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアロマ専門店行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I went to an aroma shop with Daddy!
lines.style: Quick breathy pride, words tumbling slightly over each other, bright lift on the shop.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがウルトラマンの怪獣図鑑を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad reads you the Ultraman monster encyclopedia, doesn't he.
lines.style: Soft knowing tone, fond stress on the encyclopedia, warm smile carrying the whole line.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエヴァ、つまりエヴァンゲリオンの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I watched the Eva movie with Daddy — Evangelion, I mean!
lines.style: Big excited burst, stumbling slightly over the long title, triumphant little ending.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ドスの効いた声」で物語を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, your dad reads you stories in that big, deep, growly voice, doesn't he.
lines.style: Playful hush, dipping her voice to mimic the deep reading voice, then a light laugh.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ゴキブリ対策のコツ」を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, Daddy taught me his special tricks for keeping cockroaches away!
lines.style: Earnest and serious for a six-year-old, careful on the grown-up words, quietly proud close.
